products.name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
products.description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

products.name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
products.description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

products.name: DeLaurenti Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
products.description: Our very own Chianti! Hailing from organic vineyards in the town of Montepulciano, this wine is your go-to for any and all pizza, pasta with red sauce, or anything on the grill. Mellow tannins and gorgeous, earthy, red berry notes on the nose. Our Chianti was sourced with our own dinner tables in mind- bring it home to yours today!

products.name: Bartolo Mascarello Barolo DOCG
products.description: Look, there's a reason the Barolo from Bartolo Mascarello are as legendary as they are. A time will come when you need to impress the table, and this wine will leave the party in absolute awe. A lighter-bodied expression of Nebbiolo that displays plenty of cherry, licorice, and a distinct earthy menthol quality, this wine is ready to go now but will reward the patient buyer willing to wait another half-decade or so.

products.name: Bedrock Wine Co. 'The Whole Shebang'
products.tagline: Sonoma, CA - Multi-Vintage - Zinfandel, Carignan, more...
products.description: The undeniable allure of Bedrock Wine Co.'s 'The Whole Shebang,' lies in some combination of stunning-value-without-compromise and nexus of California Zinfandel and Côtes du Rhône. Bedrock Wine Co. celebrates old-school winemaking. You’ll enjoy the fusion of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and peppery spice as it unfolds on your palate. This versatile blend is perfectly suited for a smoked brisket or a hearty mushroom risotto.

products.name: Cadence Coda
products.tagline: Red Mountain, WA - 2017 - 37% Cab Franc/29% Merlot/23% Cabernet/11% Petit Verdot
products.description: A Cabernet Franc focused red blend with fruit from around Yakima, WA, this wine is the ideal midpoint between a classic PNW red blend and a Parisian bistro wine. The prominently featured Cabernet Franc lends spice and green notes and the entirety of the wine itself is quite broad and silky. If you're looking to impress the in-laws at the next family meal but don't want to break the bank, this is definitely the way to go.

products.name: California Wine
products.tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!

products.name: Chateau Le Puy 'Emilien' Bordeaux Rouge
products.description: The only Bordeaux I really care about, honestly, says Tom Drake, our wine buyer. Chateau Le Puy has been making wine for almost 500 years and the process hasn't really changed since the beginning. The Emilien is a medium-bodied wine with ripe, velvety tannins, and cassis and blueberry aromatics with a bright finish. Roast duck breast, charcuterie, or a juicy lamb shank all make fine partners for this beauty.

products.name: Cirelli Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC
products.description: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo is a great alternative to Chianti or Barbera d'Alba. A wine that is categorically undervalued; this bottle from Cirelli is sure to over-deliver. A light, gentle pressing of organic grapes has created a medium-bodied, elegant red perfect for casual Italian-American cuisine, charcuterie, or an evening on the couch after a long day with your favorite Indian take out spot.

products.name: Cirelli Vino da Tavola Rosso
products.description: The table red is an essential tool for the home cook, and the bottle should never say 'for cooking' anywhere on the label. The wine needs to be as delicious as whatever you're cooking aims to be. And, for doing all the work, the cook should be rewarding with a shift drink for their labor. This red-fruited, juicy Montepulciano is perfect for the red sauce, the cook, and whomever is joining the cook at the dinner table.

products.name: Cor Cellars Momentum Red
products.tagline: Lyle, WA - 2018 - 38% Malbec/34% Merlot/28% Cab Franc
products.description: COR Cellars makes absolutely compelling wine from both the Columbia Gorge (for their whites) and Horse Heaven Hills (for their reds). This wine has no right to taste as amazing as it does! The Momentum punches way above its weight class and is a great apero wine with some snacks. It's also the right choice for pairing with classic red sauce-based pasta dishes and anything pork-centric.

products.name: Domaine Billard Pere & Fils Bourgonge Rouge
products.description: Jerome Billiard brings a very holistic approach to the vineyard, eschewing the use of chemical fertilizers and plowing his rows with a horse. He allows the fruit to hang on the vine a little longer than most of his neighbors and allows his wines to ferment spontaneously, too, creating a delicate Pinot Noir, pure and expressive of its alluvial soils. This is a great wine for classic bistro fare - think roast chicken, hand-made sausages, and pates.

products.name: Domaine Chante-Alouette-Cormeil Sain Emilion Grand Gru
products.tagline: Bordeaux, FR - Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon - 2012
products.description: An organically farmed, Merlot-led blend from the unique soils of Saint-Émilion. Now at peak maturity, the 2011 opens with aromas of dried plum, fig, cedar, and graphite. Medium-plus body and silky, resolved tannins carry a long, savory finish with cocoa and tobacco nuances. A graceful, classically styled Right-Bank Bordeaux.

products.name: Domaine Magdalena Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description: Savor the Old World charm of this rustic, Red Mountain masterpiece. Domaine Magdelena, a family-owned estate, embraces organic viticulture and dry farming, crafting award-winning wines for over three decades. This Cabernet Sauvignon offers robust blackberry and cassis flavors, elegantly woven with earthy undertones, sans oaky interference. A bold yet refined choice, it pairs impeccably with a savory beef bourguignon.

products.name: Envinate Albahra
products.tagline: Extremadura, SP - 2018 - 70% Garnacha Tintorera/30% Moravia Agria
products.description: Envinate (en-vin-AH-tay) translates to "wine yourself", a directive most all of us would like to happily oblige to. The group of four winemakers who founded the winery are known for producing wines from the Levant, Ribeira Sacra, and even the Canary Islands! This wine comes from the Levant and packs a lot dark fruit, violets, and spice while remaining light enough for seafood or grilled meats.

products.name: Eyrie Estate Pinot Noir
products.description: This legendary, elegant wine is a benchmark Pinot from a region renowned for its Pinots and a testament to David Lett's bold vision for Oregon's Willamette Valley. Eyrie’s vineyards are planted in Jory soil at the optimal climatic zone: high enough to access the volcanic soils of the slopes, yet low enough for heat to ripen the grapes. The estate’s dry-farmed vines yield a finely balanced, sharply defined Pinot Noir that carries the unique imprint of the terroir. Savor it alongside a succulent roast duck dish or a flavorful mushroom risotto.

products.name: Felsina 'Berardenga' Chianti Classico DOCG
products.description: Unraveling the black rooster's enigmatic charm, this wine struts its textbook Chianti Classico finesse. Proud of its Tuscan pedigree, this crowd pleaser dances on your palate. Each sip reveals layers of sumptuous earth, red cherry, and juicy plum. Raise a glass to tradition, sophistication and the pleasure of good company.

products.name: Graci Etna Rosso
products.description: If you typically enjoy Bourgogne Rouge or Willamette Valley Pinot Noir, but want to venture into Italian wine, an Etna Rosso would be a great place to start. Here on Mt. Etna, the star of the show is a grape called Nerello Mascalese, often deployed in the vineyard with slight spatterings of Nerello Cappuccio. Graci's take on this style of wine is entirely Nerello Mascalese, grown on beautiful, volcanic soils on Mt. Etna's north slope. Tantalizingly herbaceous and plentiful with tart red fruit, this is an approachable and delicious entry point to the wines from this corner of Sicily.

products.name: Grape Ink 'Days Until Harvest' Pinot Noir
products.description: This captivating Pinot Noir offers rich dark fruit, earthy undertones, and silky tannins. Derived from higher-elevation plantings, the 2021 vintage feels like a slightly more Alpine-influenced expression of the grape. In a decade, Grape Ink will be a legendary name in the region. Savor this wine today and remember the moment you discovered a rising star.

products.name: Il Monte Caro 'Ca'Rosso' Valpolicella DOC
products.description: Il Monte Caro's Valpolicella DOC showcases the true potential of the region, proving that elegance and enjoyment can coexist. This captivating wine enchants with its harmonious blend of ripe red cherries, blackberries, and a touch of spice. It is slightly more expensive, but its grace and playfulness make it well worth the splurge. Pair with prosciutto-wrapped figs or a hearty osso buco for a delightful dining experience.

products.name: Il Monte Caro Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG
products.description: It's hard to say anything novel about Amarone in this day and age. What we can all agree on is that it's quite easy to tell when a wine is a fine, hand-crafted expression of terroir, or a paint-by-numbers manufactured drink, and ever is that distinction so notable than in the category of Amarone della Valpolicella. Il Monte Caro reigns in the punchy, boozy notes sometimes found in this style, without limiting any of the wine's power. This is an intense wine, absolutely, but it's executed with precision and finesse. This wine is built to last, but should you decide to open it, it's absolutely dreamy with lamb shanks, braised beef, and the PNW's own Rogue River Blue cheese.

products.name: Il Monte Caro Valpolicella Superiore DOC
products.description: Valpolicella is one of those red wines that's such a classic and worthwhile staple because it's just so versatile. As with all the wines in this appellation, it leans heavy on Corvina, a grape almost exclusively found in Italy's Veneto region. With support from Corvinone and Rondinella grapes, the resulting wine shows bright cherry notes and just enough tannin structure to make you want to enjoy this wine with some red meat. That said, it's not too heavy, and does feel light and juicy enough that you could enjoy this wine with lighter proteins like poultry or bean dishes, or you could even enjoy it as an apertif.

products.name: Illahe 'Bon Sauvage' Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
products.description: This Willamette Valley Pinot Noir marries elegance with robust character. Illahe is a family-owned estate committed to sustainability. This barrel-selected estate Pinot has enough depth and complexity to enchant the palate with a harmonious blend of ripe raspberries, earthy tobacco, and a touch of spice. Try it with a rosemary-infused rack of lamb or za'atar-spiced roasted eggplant with a creamy tahini sauce.

products.name: Illahe Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
products.description: Illahe Vineyards embraces sustainable, horse-powered farming and traditional winemaking methods. This classic Willamette Valley mid-range Oregon Pinot Noir exudes elegance and finesse, boasting vibrant notes of raspberry, black cherry, and earthy undertones. It’s leagues better than the cheap plonk but still decently affordable. Delight your palate by pairing this captivating Pinot with a savory mushroom risotto or a sumptuous roast chicken.

products.name: Le Fontane 'Sabbe Rosse' Rosso
products.description: Le Fontane shares familial ties to the legendary COS and Occhipinti wineries in Sicily, and this new project absolutely belongs in the same conversation. The Sabbie Rosse, named so due to red clay soils in the vineyard, is like an alternate take of their Cerasuolo di Vittoria. This wine is mostly Frappato, with just over a quarter of it being Nero d'Avola. The result is a medium-ish bodied red with inviting red berry and rose notes and a lingering, raspberry-tinged finish. Delicate herbal notes on the palate pair perfectly with poultry and richer fish, like tuna or salmon.

products.name: Le Fontane Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico DOCG
products.description: Cerasuolo di Vittoria is the only DOCG in Sicily, and Le Fontane's interpretation stands comfortably among its peers as a great and delicious wine. The wine is equal parts Frappato and Nero d'Avola, showcasing the gorgeous terroir of the area via graceful herbal and red berry notes on the nose and fine, mouth-watering tannins anchored by vibrant and lingering Bing cherry notes on the palate. While the wines of Etna are rightfully on the rise at the moment, this appellation has stood the test of time and this wine in particular has quickly become a staff favorite.

products.name: Le Fraghe Bardino
products.description: Bardolino draws a lot of parallels to Valpolicella. They both utilize the same grapes, but the Bardolino appellation falls a little closer to Lake Garda. In effect, the wine region has somewhat more of a coastal influence and the wine itself is a little lighter and breezier. Takes a chill quite well, too!

products.name: Le Ragnaie Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
products.description: Generally, our favorite Brunello producer. This vintage boasts restrained oak, unleashing earthy vigor and bountiful fruit — think ripe black cherries and wild berries. Decant for a couple of hours and savor its evolving complexity. Cellaring? Tuck it away for five to eight years and prepare for a spectacular unveiling. If drinking now, decant it for at least two hours before indulging in this powerful, refined masterpiece.

products.name: Les Vignerons d'Estezargues 'Cuvee des Galets' Cotes du Rhone
products.description: Discover exceptional value in this organic marvel from Les Vignerons d'Estezargues, a trailblazing Rhône co-op championing natural winemaking. Dubbed "cave co-op with a natural twist," this wine delivers remarkable quality under $15. Revel in the harmonious blend of ripe raspberries, juicy black cherries, and a touch of spice. Elevate a simple weeknight with this standout, and let it shine alongside a hearty ratatouille or grilled lamb chops. Cheers to affordability meeting excellence.

products.name: Mark Ryan 'Lonely Heart' Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description: Mark Ryan's 'Lonely Heart' is made from relatively younger vine plantings from the esteemed Quintessence vineyard on Red Mountain. The Cabernet Sauvignon, with gentle extraction, matures for two years almost solely in new French oak, amplifying its complexity. It offers notes of blackberry, cedar, and roasted coffee with a spicy nuanced finish. It's one of the best Red Mountain wines. Match its bold sophistication with a grilled, aged ribeye steak or fettuccine with a hearty Bolognese ragu.

products.name: Mark Ryan 'The Chief' Red Blend
products.tagline: Columbia Valley, WA - 2021 - Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot
products.description: Mark Ryan’s accessibly-priced wines have earned the winery both a loyal following and the respect of elite producers. This robust Washington Cabernet Sauvignon, blended with a touch of Merlot, is intense but approachable in its youth. It tempts with aromas of black plum, vanilla, and tobacco. Pair it with grilled steak, mushroom risotto, or even better, a meal combining both!

products.name: Mark Ryan 'The Dissident' Red Wine
products.tagline: Columbia Valley, WA - 2021 - Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc Malbec, Petit Verdot
products.description: The 2021 Dissident is composed of a blend of fruit from several of Washington state’s finest vineyards. Red Mountain Cab from Quintessence and Henry Earl vineyards form the foundation, along with Merlot from Red Willow and Phinny Hill. This Mark Ryan wine is designed to be drunk a bit younger than most of his other main-label wines. With robust fruit in a well-structured blend, this approachable wine has blackberry and dark chocolate aromas and a spicy finish. Pair this one with hearty dishes like braised short ribs or beef stroganoff.

products.name: Mark Ryan Numbskull BDX
products.tagline: Columbia Valley, WA - 2020 - Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot
products.description: Mark Ryan's Numbskull BDX serves up an artful whisper of new oak and Cabernet sourced from esteemed vineyards. It's an uncomplicated delight. Expect bold black currant notes and a subtle cloak of earthiness. Pair this with a prime rib or robust vegetable stew for an experience that punches above its weight class. A lotta bang for your buck!

products.name: Plani Arche Montefalco Rosso DOC
products.description: Those familiar with Montefalco are likely informed due to their experience(s) with a grape called Sagrantino. An historic and delicious grape that stateside, at least, holds two noticeable barriers of entry: the wine's price and its absolutely massive structure. Both issues are pleasantly addressed with the Montefalco Rosso DOC. On its own, Sagrantino needs time for the tannins to incorporate and mellow out a bit. But this wine, primarily Sangiovese with just a splash of Sagrantino, is easier to approach in its youth but is peppered with those decadent, plummy, dark-fruited notes you get in full varietal expressions. Definitely the kind of wine that shines with grilled meat and American barbecue.

products.name: Plani Arche Montefalco Sagrantino DOCG
products.description: Montefalco's an historic town that sits right in the middle of Umbria, south of the more well-visted Perugia and Assili. Here, a grape called Sagrantino reigns supreme. This is not the kind of red wine you bring to someone who isn't sure if they like red wine. Everything red wine skeptics complain about has been cranked up to eleven here: the fruit, the tannins, the structure. This wine is big and bold and highly rewards the patient consumer. Decant this wine and give it plenty of time to breathe, enjoy with your favorite cuts of beef or lamb.

products.name: Podere Ruggeri Corsini 'Bricco San Pietro' Barolo DOCG
products.description: Poderi Ruggeri Corsini is a family-run winery situated in Monforte d'Alba, a historic village known for its ancient stone houses at the heart of the Langhe. This single-vineyard Barolo is elegant but still quite meaty, with well-polished tannins and a smooth finish. It features notes of ripe currants, tobacco, and cocoa powder. This Barolo is a great value, partly because Corsini wines are imported directly into the state, bypassing an intermediary. It pairs well with a hearty osso buco or a sharp, aged cheese. Eminently suitable for aging, if you can resist a Barolo that already drinks well.

products.name: Podere Ruggeri Corsini Langhe Nebbiolo DOC
products.description: Nebbiolo is the noble grape behind the likes of Barolo and Barbaresco. Notoriously difficult to grow, this grape rewards patient and skilled growers with fruit that is similarly delicate to Pinot Noir but with a little bit more bitter, earthen characteristics. While most famously known for wines that see the grape spending a long time in wood, this version of the grape is much more approachable in its youth while still showing the drinker how interesting it can be. Try it out with heartier pasta dishes and cream sauces- don't forget that this area of Italy is known for white truffles, too!

products.name: Quinta Milu La Bicicleta Voladora Rioja
products.description: This is a Rioja for fans of Beaujolais. Classic Tempranillo spice and dark fruit, but none of the power and tannins you would expect from a wine with extended elevage in oak barrels. Lighter and fresher in style, and at that weeknight-wine price!

products.name: Savage Grace Cabernet Franc
products.description: Cabernet Franc is probably most well known as the main red varietal of the Loire Valley in France. Think Saumur or Chinon, wine that is deep red in color, and smells of dark berry and green pepper. What's really quite amazing, and unfortunately we don't know how such technology was created, but winemaker Michael Savage has somehow extended the Loire Valley to reach Yakima. This expression of Cab Franc is perfect for fans of the old world and those who want balanced fruit, medium tannins, and something to pair with roasted poultry.

products.name: Sonder Red Field Blend
products.description: This Yakima-made beauty drinks like a light-bodied Cotes du Rhone. Sonder, a boutique winery, makes wines with minimal intervention to express the terroir. Their fruit-forward blend of classic Rhone varietals offers a refreshing profile of summer berries and light pepper notes. Enjoy this food-friendly wine with grilled lamb, vegetable skewers, or herb-crusted chicken thighs.

products.name: Swick Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
products.description: A classic rendition from an experimental winemaker. Joe Swick, known for daring cofermentations and extended macerations, leans into the traditional with this one. The result: a fresh and vibrant Pinot Noir that doesn't compromise on taste. Swirl the wine in your glass and revel in luscious strawberry, earthy forest floor, and a hint of spice. Pair this captivating Pinot with a delicate cedar plank salmon or a savory mushroom risotto and embrace the sublime.

products.name: Two Vintner Syrah
products.description: Two Vintners Syrah, a perennial award-winner, proves its worth as a standout, budget-friendly Washington Syrah. Laden with luscious blackberry and hints of black pepper, it displays the winery's knack for expressing the distinctive Columbia Valley terroir. This classic Syrah, celebrated for its value and consistency, pairs wonderfully with a juicy lamb shank or a smoky barbecued brisket.

products.name: Vignobles Guillaume Vin de Pays de Franche-Comte IGP
products.description: This wine hails from Franche-Comté and pours its heart into every drop. Imagine Burgundy's soulful essence, gently nudged by Jura's embrace and swayed by Côte d'Or's whispers. At a tantalizing value, each sip conjures French Pinot dreams — a delicate balance of fruit, earth, and spice. This sly, stylish delight leaves one wondering, "How am I only learning of this now?”

products.name: Villa Sant'Anna Vino Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG
products.description: Elegant and enjoyable, this Vino Nobile echoes Brunello, yet speaks its own language. Black cherry, licorice, and untamed herbs intertwine and unfold on the palate. Enjoy now or let time work its magic on this one. Paired with rosemary-infused lamb, this lavish Tuscan gem comes alive.
